contributions.detail: The 15 ruled rows on p3 sum to 36,525.00 = the printed SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE, to the cent. Adding p4's single row (2,000.00) gives 38,525.00 = the printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED on p3 = Summary Page line 1 Column A. Both printed anchors carry the same (period) scope. The 17th row emitted - Leslie Reberg, 400, marked INKIND - is written BELOW the grid and is deliberately outside BOTH printed figures, which is why the emitted row sum is 38,925.00 while the anchors say 38,525.00: the 400.00 difference is exactly that one in-kind line. This is the benign schedule-total-vs-summary-gap class (in-kind listed but not carried into the totals), so the side is EXACT against its matching anchor and nothing was adjusted.
